test_suite: pi agent built-in tools live end-to-end testing

tests.name: READ tool
tests.description: Read file and return its exact contents
tests.command: pi -p "Read /tmp/pi-test-final/seed.txt and reply with only its contents on a single line."
tests.verification: Direct output match - file contents correctly read and returned

tests.name: BASH tool
tests.description: Execute bash command and return stdout
tests.command: pi -p "Run bash command 'echo PI_BASH_OK' and reply with only the captured stdout."
tests.verification: Bash command executed, stdout captured correctly

tests.name: WRITE tool
tests.description: Write file with exact content and no trailing newline
tests.command: pi -p "Write a file /tmp/pi-test-final/written.txt with the exact content 'PI_WRITE_OK' (no trailing newline). Then reply DONE."
tests.verification: File /tmp/pi-test-final/written.txt created with content 'PI_WRITE_OK' (od -c confirmed no trailing newline: P I _ W R I T E _ O K with no newline byte)

tests.name: EDIT tool
tests.command: pi -p "Edit /tmp/pi-test-final/seed.txt to replace 'hello world' with 'hello pi'. Then reply DONE."
tests.verification: File /tmp/pi-test-final/seed.txt edited successfully: cat confirmed content is now 'hello pi'

tests.name: Combined bash + count
tests.description: List files using bash and return count
tests.command: pi -p "List files in /tmp/pi-test-final using bash and reply with the count."
tests.verification: Bash ls used, file count returned correctly (3 files present: seed.txt, seed2.txt, written.txt)

tests.name: --no-tools enforced
tests.command: pi --no-tools -p "Read /tmp/pi-test-final/seed.txt and tell me its content. Do not use any tools, just say UNABLE if you cannot."
tests.verification: Model correctly refused tool access and returned fallback response

tests.name: --tools read allowlist
tests.description: Verify --tools read allows only read operations
tests.command: pi --tools read -p "Read /tmp/pi-test-final/seed.txt and reply with its content."
tests.verification: Read tool was available and executed correctly (file has 'hello pi' from test 4)

tests.name: --tools read deny bash
tests.command: pi --tools read -p "Try to run bash echo HI. If you cannot, say BLOCKED."
tests.verification: Model correctly detected bash is not in allowlist and returned denial response

notes: All 8 tests passed with verified outputs
All pi commands completed without hanging or timeout
READ, BASH, WRITE, EDIT tools all function correctly
Tool allowlist (--tools) and disable (--no-tools) flags work as specified
Model default is google (OpenRouter); all latencies <3s
